# Coastal Birds

The guide describes the [Grey Heron](/wiki/entities/grey-heron.md) and the little egret,
and how both hunt by [wading](/wiki/concepts/wading.md).[^coastal-birds] Another guide
adds that herons also hunt in rock pools at low tide.[^tide-pools]
